_comment: Spec 38 (Motion System) FR-38-24 bundle-size budget baseline.
These are MEASURED (gzip, bytes) build actuals recorded via --update-baseline — NOT the Spec 38 section 4.4 table (which is an ESTIMATE, see script docstring).

fx-flip.js raised 381 -> 789 bytes on 2026-08-20, deliberately. +408 bytes ABSOLUTE — the 20% budget is a percentage guard, and this module is small enough that genuinely added behaviour trips it. Every byte is load-bearing: an interaction-armed rAF loop that self-stops at rest (the first version read layout EVERY FRAME FOREVER on every shop page — a direct hit on the green-CWV budget, caught in review); Flip tween tracking + killFlipsOf so a second filter mid-animation cannot capture out-of-flow geometry; product-list resolution bounded to the real list's direct children; and context.add() so the tween is reverted if reduced-motion is toggled mid-animation. Shrinking any of those back would reintroduce a reviewed defect. ⚠ The effect does NOT yet animate (cause unfound) — this records real code growth, not a working feature.
